title: Sort by Price
description: A dispatcher wants to find the most expensive shipments at a glance by clicking the price column header. Confirm the sort parameter actually reorders by priceCents, ascending and descending both.
successCondition: Book three shipments with clearly different priceCents (vary package weight or distance so the prices differ meaningfully). GET /api/tracking?sort=priceCents&order=asc returns items where, restricted to your three known shipments, priceCents values appear in non-decreasing order. GET /api/tracking?sort=priceCents&order=desc returns them in non-increasing order.
hints: Use POST /api/booking/quote first to preview prices for a few candidate packages so you can deliberately pick three that land at clearly different price points.

If the account can see other pre-existing shipments too, filter your comparison to just your three known shipment ids rather than asserting the entire array is sorted (unless you're confident the whole dataset is clean).
